notes: Hindi audio now wins over stale preferences and falls back to a Hindi-capable provider. Reels opens on the first tap in the bundled app. TFX Downloads has live progress, pause/resume/delete, audio and subtitle choices, companion audio for split-audio streams and a track-aware offline player. Live TV adds current/next programme banners, categories, channel details and a mini player that survives navigation. Picture-in-Picture is more reliable.
